basic_profile.bio: A passionate artist based in Melbourne, Australia, who loves blending digital and traditional art forms. As a freelance illustrator, I delve into the realms of fantasy and surrealism. I dislike routine and find solace in spontaneous road trips to the countryside. Typically online late at night, especially after the evening art sessions. I am single and enjoy spending time with my close-knit group of friends who share my enthusiasm for art and creativity.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught artist with a strong foundation in Art History, acquired through online courses and extensive reading. Over the years, I have honed my skills through practice and participation in various online art challenges and forums.
